datasets.name: Tiny Shakespeare · character benchmark
datasets.description: About 1.1 MB (40,000 lines) of Shakespeare plays, the classic char-rnn/nanoGPT character-level sanity benchmark. Useful for checking that loss falls and samples become Shakespeare-like; not a research corpus. Not committed: fetch it with `uv run python -m training_data.fetch_tinyshakespeare`.
datasets.license_notes: Shakespeare's works are public domain; the compilation is distributed in the MIT-licensed char-rnn repository. Kept out of Git and downloaded locally for this learning benchmark only.
